text:
zoe: quick RFC follow-up: propose a variable-span hot-sampler + compact-on-write rendezvous to fight fragmentation on large model shards
amir: tl;dr?
zoe: sample accesses to grow variable-length hot spans (token aligned if possible). on a write to a cold span, try bounded micro-copy of adjacent hot spans into staging and atomically swap mapping. fall back to async if budget exceeded
leah: sampler cost?
zoe: tiny: 2-bit saturating counter per 64KB base, bloom sketch to coalesce into spans; cap spans per-shard to keep state small
amir: atomic swap semantics? risk of torn reads
zoe: descriptor+epoch model: copy->publish single atomic descriptor swap->free old after epoch drain. no torn reads visible to serving plane
leah: staging / noisy neighbor concerns
zoe: ephemeral per-node staging pool (config ~2-3% mem). compaction credit per-tenant to throttle; reuse host-staging with tenant tags when safe
amir: eviction interplay? we don't want to compact then immediately evict
zoe: sampler contributes hotness weight to eviction score; compacted spans get locality boost so less likely to be re-evicted
leah: metrics & rollout
zoe: emit spans_detected/min, compaction_sync_ms_p50/p95, bytes_moved, staged_slots, tenant_compaction_credit; rollout: telemetry-only 2w, opt-in PoC, then ramp with kill-switches
amir: infra-bot, open tracker
infra-bot: created issue RUNTIME-9999: "variable-span hot-sampler + rendezvous compact-on-write PoC" and linked this thread :robot_face:
zoe: will open a tiny sampler PR and perf harness link later today
